title: A finite projective module is free after localizing away from each prime
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M$ a finite projective $A$-module. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$ there exists an element $f\in A\setminus\mathfrak p$ such that the localization $M_f$ is a finite free $A_f$-module.
